message: 甘い罠

name: Sacchin
message: 「I can't find it~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Truly, when you actually go looking for one, they never conveniently turn up, do they?」
Sacchin and Misasagi-senpai are peering into the bushes. Did they drop something?
Normally, the two of them would be an unusual pairing, yet seeing them together right in front of me, they strangely give off the impression of a well-balanced duo.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello there, would you like some help?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, it's the culprit, Synn-kun~! Hello~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, well, if it isn't the root of all evil making an appearance. Good day to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, why am I suddenly being blamed here?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Uuu~. Nana-chan hasn't been playing with me lately 'cause she says the Student Council is busy~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Same goes for Rii-a. Once she tells me she has Student Council duties to attend to, I can hardly invite her out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... If you want to see Nanaka or Ria-senpai, please come by the Student Council room. You'd be more than welcome.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then I wouldn't be able to have girl talk alone with Nana-chan~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「President, if you're someone who stands above others, you ought to read the room.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~. So, Synn-kun, give me a stick~」

name: Synn
message: 「A stick?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... A meat rod is a lethal weapon, ya know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, none of that, Paqy-san.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tabarah!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We wish to reclaim our beloved girls from the Student Council. Therefore, Sacchin-san and I have decided to form a united front.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even if our motives differ, so long as our goal is the same, our interests align.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Zero hour for the operation has already passed~! Behold!」
Sacchin points at the ground a short distance away from the fountain.

name: Synn
message: 「......What is that?」
A cake served on a plate sits there, with a large bamboo basket lying overturned right beside it.

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's a strawberry rare cheesecake~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I can see that, but...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's the Nanaka-han version of a sparrow-catching trap. All that's left is to prop it up with a stick, and then the plan is for us to hide in the bushes and wait.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「But we don't have a good stick~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Right... President-han, do you happen to have any milk on you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. I drank it all, so I only have the empty bottle.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That'll do just fine.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aaaand, heeeave-ho! Round and round and round~」
Sacchin wraps a long string around the milk bottle to use as a makeshift prop, and Misasagi-senpai places a large basket on top of it.

name: Sacchin
message: 「The Nana-chan Capture Trap is all done~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, shall we head into the bushes?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-As her childhood friend, let me say this for Nanaka's honor! No matter what, there's no way she'd fall for such an obvious--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mmph!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chaaan, here chick-chick-chick~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mph!? Mmmph!? Mmmph?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Come along now. Come along now.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hyaaaah~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I knew it was a trap, dammit!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's come to this, I'll at least enjoy these sweets! Munch, munch!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aaaah, my cake--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now then, next up would be Rii-a. I'll just place some kashiwamochi here instead of cake--」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not gonna fall for something like that! Hmph!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「L-Rii-a, just how long have you been standing there?」

name: Ria
message: 「I've been watching for a while now. Jeez, you don't have to pull stunts like this--I'd gladly have tea with you anytime!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Truly!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, let's have tea together too~ Here, say ahh♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Chomp, chomp, chomp!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sniff, sniff, Nana-chan's mad at me~ Do something, Synn-kun~」
With a great deal of effort, I soothe Nanaka. Is this really part of a Student Council President's duties... I wonder?
